_meta.description: Maps the 18 product types from ProductSelectionFlow to PlaySkills and dome node signals. Used to recommend product types based on a user's dome + skill profile.

one_to_one.label: 1:1 Service
one_to_one.description: You work with one person at a time. Deep transformation, premium pricing, limited by your calendar.

one_to_many.label: 1:Many Service
one_to_many.description: You deliver to groups. Workshops, classes, group sessions. More leverage than 1:1 but still requires your presence.

custom_service.label: Custom Service
custom_service.description: You design bespoke solutions for each client. High value, high effort, hard to scale.

packaged_service.label: Packaged Service
packaged_service.description: A standardised program delivered to clients. Same method, repeatable results. The bridge between service and product.

hybrid_service.label: Hybrid Service
hybrid_service.description: Part human, part digital. Live coaching plus self-paced content. Best of both worlds.

group_program.label: Group Program
group_program.description: A cohort moves through a structured program together. Community creates accountability. You teach once, many benefit.

automated_group.label: Self-Paced Course
automated_group.description: Record once, sell forever. The classic scalable product. No calendar dependency.

live_group.label: Live Cohort
live_group.description: A live group with a start and end date. Higher engagement than self-paced, more scalable than 1:1.

managed_service.label: Done-For-You
managed_service.description: You do the work for them using your system. Agency model. Scales with a team, not just you.

membership.label: Membership
membership.description: People pay monthly to be part of your world. Community is the product. Value compounds with every member.

digital_product.label: Digital Product
digital_product.description: Templates, ebooks, guides, presets. Make once, distribute infinitely. Low price, high volume.

tech_digital.label: Tech/Digital Tool
tech_digital.description: An app, tool, or platform that solves a problem. Build once, users multiply.

software.label: Software/SaaS
software.description: Subscription software. The ultimate recurring revenue model. Core offer IS continuity.

physical_product.label: Physical Product
physical_product.description: Something people hold. Supplements, equipment, merchandise, food products. Margins in manufacturing, moat in brand.

content_podcast.label: Podcast
content_podcast.description: Long-form audio. Builds deep trust over time. Primarily an attraction vehicle that can monetise via sponsorship or premium.

content_newsletter.label: Newsletter
content_newsletter.description: Written content delivered to inboxes. Builds authority. Monetises via sponsorship, paid tier, or as a funnel to other products.

content_youtube.label: YouTube Channel
content_youtube.description: Video content at scale. The most powerful attraction vehicle. Ad revenue plus funnel to premium products.

mixed_products.label: Mixed Products
mixed_products.description: Multiple product types combined. The mature creator's portfolio. Each product feeds the others.
